changes.reason: Add an explicit Workers R2Bucket entry while preserving the root S3 adapter and its Node/Lambda support. No core storage engine or provisioning is introduced.

kubernetes.reason: The new entry requires a Worker-owned R2Bucket binding. Existing root S3 code and its Node/Lambda lifecycle and credentials are unchanged; this change makes no new claim for that host.

cloudflare.reason: Package-wide Workers support remains unclaimed: only the explicit /workers binding subset runs in the local workerd R2 fixture. The root S3 API and full deployment are outside that claim.
constraints: Requires application-owned R2Bucket binding and native nodejs_compat for the common DI contract.
Local workerd R2 storage only; no live Cloudflare account, deployed resource or provider certification.
No signing or object ACL; native known-length upload streams only; get buffers at most 10MiB.
Cancellation stops waiting and read consumption, not remote write/delete commit; no automatic retry or distributed transaction guarantee.
Application owns authenticated tenant/key selection and callback lifetime; binding has no shutdown/flush API.
